description: Declared mutants of the transform Module (docs/architecture/target/v2/transform-camera-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 6.3; Design Invariants TF-1 to TF-4 in docs/architecture/target/v2/transform.zh-Hant.md; ids tf-). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails with the expected message.

mutants.what: the initial value of GlobalTransform is the identity (Bevy's require) instead of ComposeTRS(Transform). Only it catches a wrong first value at the spawn's sync point
SyncTransforms is not registered: a written Transform never reaches GlobalTransform
SyncTransforms drops Changed<Transform> and writes every frame. Only it catches GlobalTransform written when Transform was not
mutants.cases: transform: a frame that writes no Transform*

mutants.what: the OnAdd hook of Transform is not registered: an entity Restore brings back has no GlobalTransform (Restore derives no initial value, DI-KS 12)
mutants.cases: transform: Restore brings an entity back*

mutants.what: GlobalTransform's hash writes the matrix: a derived value changes the summary
mutants.replace: inline void HashValue(Kernel::Hasher& h, const GlobalTransform& v) { Kernel::HashValue(h, v.matrix.values); }

mutants.what: Transform's hash leaves the scale out: two Worlds with different scales have one summary
Transform's == compares floats instead of bits: -0 equals +0, so Restore skips a cell whose hash differs (rollback R-2)

the hook puts the identity instead of ComposeTRS(Transform). Only it catches a wrong value put at the restore (the propagation overwrites it by the end of the frame, so tf-restore-hook-missing's check of presence does not)
mutants.cases: transform: Restore brings an entity back*

mutants.what: SyncTransforms is not put in the public set TransformPropagate: a System ordered after the set runs before the propagation. The set is then empty and the kernel reports the reader's order as D-E4 at startup; the case tags that failure too
mutants.cases: transform: a System ordered after TransformPropagate*

mutants.what: the default stage of SyncTransforms is Last instead of PostUpdate (Bevy's): a PostUpdate reader after the set reads last frame's value. Only it catches the default stage
mutants.cases: transform: a System ordered after TransformPropagate*

mutants.what: transform link set on the real tree (README rule 4: positive control): the transform row depends on one more Module (json, a row before transform). Only gyo_expect_links on gyo_transform stops it
mutants.find: and keeping them equal for entities without a parent",no,yes,,,
mutants.replace: and keeping them equal for entities without a parent",no,yes,json,,
